text: DSH Git View 是面向 Web 客户端的 DSH 插件，会在对话视图中注册 Git 面板，读取会话工作区中的仓库状态。它可以列出工作区项目、按冲突和暂存状态查看文件、浏览统一或并排差异，并提供暂存、提交、分支、stash、拉取和推送操作。用户也可以在面板编辑工作树文件，并从暂存差异生成提交信息。适合希望在 DSH 会话中直接检查和管理 Git 变更的人。需要会话位于 Git 仓库且主机有 Git；生成提交信息会把暂存 diff 发送给当前配置的模型服务。

DSH Git View adds a Git panel to the DSH web conversation view. Review workspace repositories and file diffs, edit files, and stage, commit, branch, stash, pull or push changes. Commit messages can be drafted from the staged diff using the configured model.
我想在 DSH 对话里直接看看当前项目有哪些 Git 改动。
能不能并排对比修改前后的文件内容？
I want to stage and commit selected changes without leaving my DSH session.
DSH Git View 的功能「浏览工作区变更」：在对话视图的 Git 面板查看会话仓库状态和变更文件。选择文件后可查看统一差异或并排内容，并打开文件进行编辑保存。
DSH Git View 的功能「管理 Git 操作」：从文件列表选择变更后暂存或取消暂存，并可提交、切换或创建分支、处理 stash、拉取和推送；生成提交信息时使用配置的模型读取暂存差异。
DSH Git View 生成提交信息时会将暂存区 diff（最多 60,000 字节）发送给当前配置的模型服务；不使用此功能时不会触发该模型请求。

@shin/dsh-git-view README · What it does：A **Git** tab in the conversation view ring, after Trajectory. It reads the
repository the session is working in — no path to configure, no second UI.

@shin/dsh-git-view README · What it does：- **Every project in the workspace** — the repositories around the working
  directory, each with its own branch, markers and commit. They are committed
  separately, never across repositories. Projects with nothing pending fold into
  one row so the ones you are actually working on stay on screen.
- **Change groups** — conflicts, staged, unstaged and untracked, each with
  folder rows that fold a whole subtree and stage or discard it in one action.
- **Three ways to read a file** — whole file with the changes marked, changes
  only as a unified diff, or side by side. Remembered across sessions.
- **Edit and save** — open a working-tree file in the panel and write it back,
  guarded by the version the read returned.
- **Branches, stash, pull, sync** — and a fetch, refresh and discard group.
- **Commit and push** — an AI-written commit message from the staged diff, a
  commit button that commits, and a push button that lists every commit it would
  publish before it publishes them.

@shin/dsh-git-view README · What it does：Untracked directories stay folded until opened, and opening one asks git about
that directory alone. A working tree with twenty thousand untracked files costs
the same to list as one with twenty.

A repository nested inside another one is not offered as a folder in its
parent's file list, because git will not describe what is inside it to the
parent and opening one would show nothing. It is one of the projects instead.

@shin/dsh-git-view README · Install：Requires dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer, Node 22.19+ or 24+, and a session whose
working directory is a git repository.

It is in the plugin market. To install it by hand, either path works:

```sh
@shin/dsh-git-view README · prebuilt, no build-approval step：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/shinchen6/dsh-git-view/releases/latest/download/dsh-git-view.tgz

@shin/dsh-git-view README · Screenshots：The push button lists what it would publish first.

The commit box enlarges from its top-right control.
